comparison_contract.data: Fully populated nonzero 8/64 MiB origins and prepared references; all source/reference/destination data validated with independently regenerated full-file hashes.
comparison_contract.baseline: Explicit 64 KiB File::read/write_all into create_new files, with no fs::copy, copy_file_range, reflink ioctl or sparse placeholder.
comparison_contract.execution_order: Exactly two warmup pairs plus eight measured pairs per group; alternating AB/BA with four original-first and four copy-first measured pairs.
comparison_contract.return_boundary: Operation/API return; original in-memory indexing and metadata projection included; both operation wrappers issue matching directory-entry fsync calls but original ignores internal fsync errors.
comparison_contract.caller_durable_boundary: Operation plus enforced sync_all of all newly produced files and all ancestor directories through the owned XFS mount root, with matching observed namespace layouts.
comparison_contract.outside_timer: Whole-file validation, source/reference warming, bidirectional patches, source restoration, namespace enumeration, trial cleanup, metrics, report serialization/persistence.
comparison_contract.between_trial_cleanup_limit: Original delete APIs issue directory fsyncs outside the timer. Explicit-copy cleanup unlinks outside the timer but does not separately fsync deleted directories. This cleanup/writeback asymmetry requires a fresh corrected cohort before stronger equivalence claims; the frozen source and all measurements are retained unchanged.
comparison_contract.cache: Warm-cache component experiment; no cache dropping or syncfs.
comparison_contract.statistics: Paired median full-copy/original ratios and ratios of method medians are both retained and named separately. All eight raw pairs, ranges, distributions and deterministic order-stratified descriptive bootstrap bounds are preserved for every group.

next_fairness_cohort: Match directory cleanup fsync outside both timers, retain original source, fresh owned storage, the complete fixed matrix and all failed attempts. Then execute original fanout/dirty-I/O scenarios and measure complete graded episode effects separately.
